chapter.heading: Plea for Purity
chapter.v:
for you
know what commandments we gave you through the Lord Jesus.

that each
of you should know how to possess his own vessel in sanctification and honor, [[2 Pet. 2:20]]

that no
one should take advantage of and defraud his brother in this matter, because the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also forewarned you and testified.

For God
did not call us to uncleanness, but in holiness. [Prov. 2:6 2 NU]

Therefore he
who rejects this does not reject man, but God, who has also given us His Holy Spirit.A Brotherly and Orderly Life [Rom. 1:3,]

and indeed
you do so toward all the brethren who are in all Macedonia. But we urge you, brethren, that you increase more and more;

that you
also aspire to lead a quiet life, to mind your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you, [Rom. 6:5, 8;]

that you
may walk properly toward those who are outside, and that you may lack nothing.The Comfort of Christ’s Coming [Matt. 10:33;] [[Matt. 19:28]; Luke 22:29; [Rom. 5:17; 8:17]]

But I
do not want you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning those who have fallen asleep, lest you sorrow as others who have no hope. [Num. 23:19;]

For if
we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with Him those who sleep in Jesus. [1 Tim.]

For this
we say to you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive and remain until the coming of the Lord will by no means precede those who are asleep. [1 Tim. 4:13;]

For the
Lord Himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of an archangel, and with the trumpet of God. And the dead in Christ will rise first.

Then we
who are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And thus we shall always be with the Lord. [1 Tim. 1:20]

Therefore comfort
one another with these words. [1 Cor. 15:12]
